title: ITVX / Living-room interface
slide_intent: Check that brand recognition supports content discovery at television distance, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: A television in a domestic room displays a dark ITVX browsing interface with rows of programme artwork and navigation along the left.
practical_value: Check that brand recognition supports content discovery at television distance.

content_islands.name: Screen
content_islands.spec: Programme tiles dominate the browsing surface.

content_islands.name: Navigation
content_islands.spec: A compact left-hand rail separates service controls from content.

reference_purposes.Expression: A television in a domestic room displays a dark ITVX browsing interface with rows of programme artwork and navigation along the left.
reference_purposes.Application: Check that brand recognition supports content discovery at television distance. Evidence is the shown application, not a mandatory layout rule.
